profile.subject: a slender grey tabby cat
profile.styleHints: Grey tabby stripes, ringed tail, large upright ears, green eyes

cycle.prompt: a slender grey tabby cat with black stripes and ringed tail walking, strict side profile facing right, one green eye visible, large upright ears, legs in quadruped walk sequence, tail extended, same size in every frame, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps, horizontal sprite sheet of exactly 4 frames

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: standing alert in side view facing right, tail low, head up, large ears perked, watching

rest.label: Sit Pretty
rest.prompt: Pose: sitting upright with hind legs folded, front paws straight, tail curled around paws, ears forward

sleep.label: Curl Up Nap
sleep.prompt: Pose: curled up asleep in a tight loaf, seen from the side, eyes closed, paws tucked under the chest; exactly one tail, wrapped along the front of the body with the tip beside the front paws; nothing over the face

voice.label: Meow
voice.prompt: Pose: sitting with mouth open meowing, head tilted up, ears perked, tail upright

trick.label: Pounce Play
trick.prompt: Pose: in playful pounce crouch with front low, rear up, tail high with striped tip, eyes wide

facts.text: Egyptian Maus are the only naturally spotted pet cat breed.
They can run up to 30 miles per hour, super fast!
Mau means cat in Egyptian, and they love to play fetch.
